about: What the test run cannot see for itself. scripts/plugins-python.mjs runs every official plugin and labels it from what happened; a plugin that runs without an error but cannot do its job here (it needs a program on the computer, a local server, …) is labelled by hand below, and these entries win over the run.

com.github.adamws.kicad-git.note: Its button opens the Save Version dialog. The project's version history stands in for git here: a commit is a saved version.

com.github.bbenchoff.orthoroute.note: Its button runs, but its window is built with PyQt6, which the web editor does not have, so the router window does not open.

com.github.danielboston38.prefab-gate.note: Its check runs on the web editor's Design Rules Checker, which covers fewer rules than KiCad's desktop DRC. Zones are refilled first by the web editor's own filler. Read a pass as a first check, not as KiCad's verdict.

com.github.samuelcicuitstudio.traceforge.note: Its helper and its panel both run in the page and talk over a local port that stays inside the page. The first launch sets its net highlight shortcut and asks to be opened again, as on the desktop. Signal paths, export, rotation, via and trace tools, net colours and manufacturing checks work. Stitching, fences and rounded corners need the shapely package. Teardrops drive KiCad's own Windows dialog, on the desktop too, and are not available here.

com.github.usetraces.traces.note: It is a client for the traces server (traces-serve), which is installed separately from its own source and is not part of this package. A plugin here cannot reach a server on your own computer.

com.infernoembedded.vulcans-trials.note: The package holds only a launcher for the vulcans-trials program, a compiled desktop application that is installed separately. Without it the plugin reports that it cannot find the program, on the desktop too.

com.github.z2labs.z2ems.note: Its windows open and the setup is saved. Simulating needs the Z2 EMS engine, a desktop program.

com.github.fablabkerala.gerber2png-plugi.note: It makes the Gerber archive and hands it over as a download. Passing it straight to the Gerber2Png page needs a local network port: open that page and load the archive there.

com.github.f-blaze.velatrace.note: Its window opens and its own router routes the board and draws the preview. Its approval step checks the route with the web editor's Design Rules Checker, which covers fewer rules than KiCad's desktop DRC, and its optional Freerouting engine needs Java on a computer.

com.github.drewsum.kipi.note: Its Qt window and its numpy, scipy and matplotlib parts load. Its solver meshes the copper with the Triangle library, which is compiled code that has no build for the browser.
